base_url.label: AudioMuse-AI server URL
base_url.description: Root URL of your AudioMuse-AI server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000

api_token.label: API token
api_token.description: Optional API token, sent as a Bearer header. Leave empty if auth is off.

media_provider.label: Media provider to map against
media_provider.description: The Music Assistant provider that points at the same media server AudioMuse-AI analyzed. Track ids are matched through this provider.

enable_text_search.label: Enable free-text search
enable_text_search.description: Expose AudioMuse-AI's CLAP + lyrics search as a search provider.

manifest.description: Library-wide Similar Tracks, an 'Inspired by recently played' discover row, and free-text search, powered by an external AudioMuse-AI server. Requires a running AudioMuse-AI instance pointed at the same media server you use in Music Assistant.
